benchmark.$comment: Benchmark protocol fields must be static values; runtime shell expansion would make the protocol digest ambiguous. The protocol digest binds resolved parameters and referenced spec content. It is not a claim that two hosts are performance-comparable. Target identity, endpoint-contract version, topology id, and topology-spec digest enter both the protocol and comparison-key digests. Direct and PgBouncer series are distinct populations, not interchangeable baselines. `BENCHMARK_CONNECT_PER_TRANSACTION=1` must use `pgbench.latency_mean_us`; reconnect TPS includes connection setup and is retained as secondary evidence rather than relabeled as ordinary `pgbench.tps`. Cache, operator-managed statistics resets, collector calibration, client placement outside qualified A/B, and resource budgets are recorded declarations unless a runtime gate explicitly verifies them. `BENCHMARK_CONTRACT_VERSION=2` never reinterprets v1 warm, cold, steady, operator-managed, operator-calibrated, or operator-declared declarations; unsupported v2 control modes fail closed. Use BENCHMARK_CLASS=smoke only for fast contract and portability checks.
benchmark.description: Benchmark specs live under `benchmarks/**/*.env` and define one immutable pgbench measurement protocol over an existing experiment and workload.

BENCHMARK_ALLOWED_SUBJECT_DIFFERENCES.description: The one explicit subject dimension permitted by counterbalanced A/B; native_toolchain requires two byte-distinct seven-file executable snapshots with matching observed versions for all seven selected tools.

BENCHMARK_CACHE_MIN_RESIDENT_PCT.description: Minimum pg_buffercache resident-block percentage required for every target relation.

BENCHMARK_CACHE_REGIME.description: V1 is declaration-only. V2 can gate exact target-relation residency in PostgreSQL shared buffers; neither contract controls the operating-system page cache.

BENCHMARK_CACHE_TARGET_RELATIONS.description: Exact target relation set whose shared-buffer residency must be evidenced before measure.

BENCHMARK_CLASS.description: Evidence class. Smoke exercises the contract but is not performance evidence.

BENCHMARK_CLIENTS.description: Pgbench client count recorded in the protocol.

BENCHMARK_CLIENT_PLACEMENT.description: Declared pgbench client placement. Ordinary runs do not attest it; v2 runner-enforced single-container resources require same-host, and counterbalanced A/B requires matching strict qualification bookends.

BENCHMARK_COLLECTORS.description: Exact space-separated collector set selected by the explicit protocol contract.

BENCHMARK_COLLECTOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: PostgreSQL sampler interval in seconds; the benchmark runner passes this value to the sampler.

BENCHMARK_COLLECTOR_MAX_DUTY_CYCLE_PCT.description: Maximum permitted per-sample collector duty cycle; every retained sample participates.

BENCHMARK_COLLECTOR_OVERHEAD_MODE.description: V1 operator calibration is declaration-only. V2 runner calibration retains exact-cadence raw timing rows and independently derives the duty-cycle gate.

BENCHMARK_COLLECTOR_OVERHEAD_SAMPLES.description: Minimum number of raw monotonic sampler timing rows required for the duty-cycle gate.

BENCHMARK_CONNECT_PER_TRANSACTION.description: Open a new database connection for every pgbench transaction and require reconnect-specific result evidence. This mode must use mean latency as its primary metric because its TPS includes reconnection time.

BENCHMARK_CONTRACT_VERSION.description: Explicit protocol contract. Version 1 preserves declaration-only legacy controls; version 2 opts in to runner-produced control evidence and strict supported modes.

BENCHMARK_CPU_BUDGET_CORES.description: Declared CPU core budget; forbidden when the resource budget mode is unbounded.

BENCHMARK_CPU_BUDGET_MILLICORES.description: Runner-enforced Docker CPU budget in integer millicores; v2 forbids BENCHMARK_CPU_BUDGET_CORES.

BENCHMARK_DIRECTION.description: Improvement direction: TPS is higher, mean latency is lower.

BENCHMARK_DRIVER.description: Measurement driver; benchmark contracts v1 and v2 support pgbench only.

BENCHMARK_EXPERIMENT_SPEC.description: Experiment spec that owns the disposable runtime and prepared database state.

BENCHMARK_LATENCY_LIMIT_MS.description: Optional pgbench latency limit in milliseconds.

BENCHMARK_LOG_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Sampling rate used when transaction logging is enabled.

BENCHMARK_LOG_TRANSACTIONS.description: Capture raw per-transaction pgbench logs for audit and later percentile analysis.

BENCHMARK_MAX_CV_PCT.description: Maximum coefficient of variation for a stable measured series.

BENCHMARK_MAX_LATENCY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED_PCT.description: Maximum allowed percentage of completed transactions above the latency limit; exceeding it invalidates the trial.

BENCHMARK_MAX_TRIES.description: Optional maximum transaction tries. Zero means unlimited and requires fixed-time mode or a latency limit.

BENCHMARK_MEMORY_BUDGET_MIB.description: Memory budget in MiB; forbidden when the resource budget mode is unbounded.
BENCHMARK_MEMORY_BUDGET_MIB.x-workbench-requirement: required for v1 operator-declared or v2 runner-enforced

BENCHMARK_MIN_VALID_TRIALS.description: Minimum valid trials required for an aggregate result; cannot exceed BENCHMARK_TRIALS.

BENCHMARK_MODE.description: Termination mode for each measured pgbench trial.

BENCHMARK_PG_CONFIG.description: PostgreSQL config profile applied to benchmark trials.

BENCHMARK_PRIMARY_METRIC.description: Primary metric used by summaries and comparisons.

BENCHMARK_RANDOM_SEED.description: Explicit deterministic measure seed N; warmup uses N+1, with maximum-int wrap to 0, and both derived phase seeds are protocol-bound.

BENCHMARK_RATE.description: Optional target transaction rate passed to pgbench.

BENCHMARK_REGRESSION_THRESHOLD_PCT.description: Optional material-regression threshold; omission keeps comparisons descriptive.

BENCHMARK_RESET_POLICY.description: Database-state policy between trials. Reuse is restricted to pgbench select-only workloads.

BENCHMARK_RESOURCE_BUDGET_MODE.description: V1 records but does not enforce limits. V2 runner enforcement is restricted to the exact Docker single-container Linux cgroup-v2 provider.

BENCHMARK_RESOURCE_BUDGET_SCOPE.description: Fixed v2 scope: server and in-container pgbench share the enforced Docker limit.

BENCHMARK_RESOURCE_ENFORCEMENT_PROVIDER.description: Exact supported provider. Native runs and other resource-control providers fail closed.

BENCHMARK_SCALE.description: Pgbench scale factor recorded in the protocol.

BENCHMARK_STATISTICS_RESET_BOUNDARY.description: Declared reset boundary; must be none exactly when the reset policy is none.

BENCHMARK_STATISTICS_RESET_POLICY.description: V1 records operator-managed resets without proof. V2 runner-managed mode executes and verifies current-database and WAL reset evidence at the declared boundary.

BENCHMARK_TARGET.description: Digest-bound pgbench endpoint contract. `direct-postgres` requires the `single` topology and supports Docker or native execution; `pgbouncer` requires the `pgbouncer` topology and Docker execution.

BENCHMARK_THREADS.description: Pgbench worker thread count recorded in the protocol.

BENCHMARK_TRANSACTIONS_PER_CLIENT.description: Measured transaction count per client; incompatible with BENCHMARK_MEASURE_SECONDS.

BENCHMARK_WARMUP_SECONDS.description: Warmup duration inside each trial; excluded from the measured result.

BENCHMARK_WORKLOAD_SPEC.description: Workload spec used for the measured pgbench command.

benchmark.title: benchmark env spec

dataset.description: Dataset specs live under `datasets/**/*.env` and load reusable data before an experiment workload.

DATASET_PROFILE.description: Profile setup SQL used as dataset source.

DATASET_ROWS.description: Row count variable passed to dataset SQL.

DATASET_SCHEMA.description: Target schema variable passed to dataset SQL.

DATASET_SEED.description: Seed variable passed to dataset SQL.

dataset.title: dataset env spec

experiment.$comment: Keep interpretation profile-local; experiment specs should describe orchestration. Foreground and background workload specs use the workload contract. Declarative SQL hooks do not require shell trust. Any host-shell hook fails closed unless `EXPERIMENT_TRUSTED_SHELL=1`; this marker is not a sandbox for the sourced env spec.
experiment.description: Experiment specs live under `experiments/**/*.env` and orchestrate topology, setup, workload, monitoring, assertions, and artifacts.

EXPERIMENT_AFTER_SHELL.description: Trusted host-shell hook run after workload; requires `EXPERIMENT_TRUSTED_SHELL=1`.

EXPERIMENT_AFTER_SQL_FILES.description: Space-separated SQL files run after workload.

EXPERIMENT_ASSERT_TRUE_SQL.description: Boolean SQL assertion that must return exactly one `t` row.

EXPERIMENT_BACKGROUND_WAIT.description: Wait for background workloads before after-hooks.

EXPERIMENT_BACKGROUND_WARMUP.description: Seconds to wait after background workloads start.

EXPERIMENT_BEFORE_SHELL.description: Trusted host-shell hook run before snapshots/workload; requires `EXPERIMENT_TRUSTED_SHELL=1`.

EXPERIMENT_BEFORE_SQL_FILES.description: Space-separated SQL files run before snapshots/workload.

EXPERIMENT_DATASET_SIZE.description: Dataset size passed to dataset loader.

EXPERIMENT_DATASET_SPEC.description: Dataset spec loaded before profile/workload execution.

EXPERIMENT_METRICS_SAMPLES.description: Fixed sample count; overrides duration loop.

EXPERIMENT_PROFILE_SECONDS.description: Profile duration passed to profile SQL.

EXPERIMENT_PROFILE_SIZE.description: Profile scale passed to profile SQL.

EXPERIMENT_RUNTIME_RESET.description: Reset the selected disposable runtime before the run.

EXPERIMENT_STATE_WRITER.description: State-file writer mode for manifest and verdict artifacts. `auto` is a compatibility alias for `go`; legacy `shell` is rejected for v1 evidence.

EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT.description: Runner execution deadline; CLI `--timeout` and `PGWORKBENCH_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT` take precedence.

experiment.title: experiment env spec

matrix.description: Matrix specs live under `matrices/**/*.env` and expand experiments across config/profile-size/repeat combinations.

MATRIX_RUNTIME_RESET.description: Reset the selected runtime before each run.

MATRIX_STOP_ON_FAIL.description: Stop matrix after first failed run.

matrix.title: matrix env spec

topology.$comment: Topology implementation remains in shell/Docker Compose adapters.
topology.description: Topology specs live under `topologies/**/*.env` and describe supported runtime shapes.

TOPOLOGY_NAME.description: Topology id; must match the spec id.

topology.title: topology env spec

utility-suite.$comment: Suite runs delegate each entry to `pgworkbench utility run`, so per-test artifacts still live under `runs/<run-id>/`.
utility-suite.description: Utility suite specs live under `utility-suites/**/*.env` and batch utility-test specs across profile sizes and repeats.

UTILITY_SUITE_STOP_ON_FAIL.description: Stop suite execution after the first failed utility test run.

utility-suite.title: utility-suite env spec

utility-test.$comment: Use utility tests for pg_dump, pg_restore, pg_upgrade, external backup tools, data checkers, fuzzers, and other PostgreSQL-adjacent utilities. Values containing `$` are treated as dynamic by the validator and are not path-checked. SQL assertions do not require shell trust. `UTILITY_TEST_EXPECT_FILES` currently compiles to host-shell `test -s` checks and shares the explicit trust gate with `UTILITY_TEST_ASSERT_SHELL`.
utility-test.description: Utility test specs live under `utility-tests/**/*.env` and describe a reusable PostgreSQL utility/tool test scenario.

UTILITY_TEST_ASSERT_SHELL.description: Trusted host-shell assertion run after the utility workload; requires `UTILITY_TEST_TRUSTED_SHELL=1`.

UTILITY_TEST_ASSERT_SQL.description: Inline SQL assertion run after the utility workload.

UTILITY_TEST_ASSERT_SQL_FILES.description: Space-separated SQL assertion files run after the utility workload.

UTILITY_TEST_ASSERT_TRUE_SQL.description: Boolean SQL assertion that must return exactly one `t` row.

UTILITY_TEST_BACKGROUND_SPECS.description: Space-separated background workload specs started before the utility workload.

UTILITY_TEST_BACKGROUND_WAIT.description: Wait for background workloads after the foreground utility workload.

UTILITY_TEST_BACKGROUND_WARMUP.description: Seconds to wait after background workloads start.

UTILITY_TEST_DATASET_SIZE.description: Dataset size passed to the dataset loader.

UTILITY_TEST_DATASET_SPEC.description: Dataset spec loaded before background and utility workloads.

UTILITY_TEST_EXPECT_FILES.description: Space-separated output files checked in the host shell; requires `UTILITY_TEST_TRUSTED_SHELL=1`.

UTILITY_TEST_METRICS.description: Enable metrics sampling during the utility test.

UTILITY_TEST_METRICS_SAMPLES.description: Fixed metrics sample count; overrides duration loop.

UTILITY_TEST_NOTES.description: Short operator notes for expected evidence or caveats.

UTILITY_TEST_PROFILE.description: Profile directory under `profiles/` used to prepare database state.

UTILITY_TEST_PROFILE_SECONDS.description: Profile duration passed to setup/run SQL when used.

UTILITY_TEST_PROFILE_SIZE.description: Profile scale passed to setup SQL.

UTILITY_TEST_SCAN_PATHS.description: Extra paths scanned for failure evidence.

UTILITY_TEST_TRUSTED_SHELL.description: Explicitly allow utility assertions that execute in the host shell.

UTILITY_TEST_WORKLOAD_SPEC.description: Foreground workload spec that invokes the utility or external tool.

utility-test.title: utility-test env spec

workload.$comment: Values containing `$` are treated as dynamic by the validator and are not path-checked. Tool-specific knobs can live in workload specs as long as the adapter consumes them.
workload.description: Workload specs live under `workloads/**/*.env` and define one foreground or background executable workload.

NOISIA_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Extra noisia arguments split as shell words. Experiment-owned runs reject conninfo and option-terminator overrides.

PGBENCH_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Extra pgbench arguments split as shell words. Experiment-owned runs reject host, port, user, database, and option-terminator overrides.

PGBENCH_MODE.description: Builtin pgbench mode passed with `-b` when no script is set.

PGBENCH_TIME.description: Run duration in seconds when transactions are unset.

PG_BUILD_CFLAGS.description: CFLAGS used by PostgreSQL source builds.

PG_CHECK_TARGET.description: Make target for PostgreSQL source tests.

PG_CLONE_DEPTH.description: Git clone depth for PostgreSQL source.

PG_CONFIGURE_ARGS.description: Configure arguments for PostgreSQL source builds.

PG_PATCH_DIR.description: Ad hoc patch directory; overrides the directory from `PG_PATCHSET`.

PG_SOURCE_KEEP_GOING.description: When `1`, scan artifacts even if the make target failed.

PG_TEST_INITDB_EXTRA_OPTS.description: Extra initdb options passed to PostgreSQL source test targets.

SQL.description: Repository or absolute SQL path for `WORKLOAD_KIND=sql`.
SQL.x-workbench-requirement: required for sql if WORKLOAD_SQL is empty

UTILITY_ARCHIVE_FILE.description: Custom-format archive used for the pg_restore round trip.

UTILITY_OUTPUT_FILE.description: Host-side output file written atomically by a PostgreSQL utility adapter.

UTILITY_SOURCE_SCHEMA.description: Source schema selected for a dump or restore round trip.
UTILITY_SOURCE_SCHEMA.x-workbench-requirement: optional for pg-dump; required for pg-restore

UTILITY_TARGET_SCHEMA.description: Schema name produced by the isolated pg_restore round trip.

WORKLOAD_CMD.description: Host shell command run with PostgreSQL connection env exported.

WORKLOAD_COMMAND.description: Command run in the Compose workload service.

WORKLOAD_REQUIRES_POSTGRES.description: Set to `0` for host-only workloads that do not need the PostgreSQL container.

WORKLOAD_RUN_LOG.description: Set to `0` to stream directly without a workload log wrapper.

WORKLOAD_SQL.description: Profile SQL file name or repository SQL path.

workload.title: workload env spec
